# Photo filter editor

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/image-filters/

Adjust brightness, contrast and saturation, then optionally apply black-and-white or sepia styling. Export your edited photo locally.

## How to use it

1. Choose a clear, supported image from your device.
2. Adjust the image settings and run the tool.
3. Inspect the preview, then download or copy the result.

## Example

Increase a dim image’s brightness slightly and compare it with a desaturated version.

## Limits and checks

Filters change pixel appearance and do not restore missing detail. Extreme settings can clip highlights, shadows or color.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
